description: Laravel package (lomkit/laravel-rest-api) that turns Eloquent models into a JSON API with search, nested writes, actions and metrics, checked against Laravel policies and documented in OpenAPI.
rules: These docs cover Laravel Rest Api 3.x (lomkit/laravel-rest-api), which requires PHP 8.3+ and Laravel 13.30+. Do not write 2.x code: 3.x fields are typed objects such as Text::make('name'), never plain strings.
Install with composer require lomkit/laravel-rest-api. php artisan rest:quick-start writes the resources, controllers, policies and routes of the models you choose.

Declare one resource per model in app/Rest/Resources and a thin controller in app/Rest/Controllers with public static string $resource; register its routes with Rest::resource('products', ProductsController::class).
Only what a resource declares exists for clients: fields(), relations(), scopes(), actions(), instructions(). A field, relation or scope that the resource does not declare gives a 422.

Read rows with POST /api/{resource}/search and a JSON body under the search key (filters, sorts, selects, includes, aggregates, page, limit). Write with POST /api/{resource}/mutate and a mutate list of operations.
Every endpoint checks the Laravel policies of each resource a request reaches and of each row it writes. Keep tenant and visibility constraints in perimeterQuery() of the resource.
Prefer an action (php artisan rest:action) or an instruction to a custom controller method, and never add Route::apiResource() for a model that a resource already exposes.
Request sizes and nesting depths are limited by rest.limits in config/rest.php. Do not spell out default values in request payloads.
